title: CrossDiff: Diffusion Probabilistic Model With Cross-conditional Encoder-Decoder for Crack Segmentation
mechanism: Diffusion probabilistic crack segmenter with a cross-encoder (detail) and cross-decoder (semantics).
evidence: R: five crack sets (CFD, CrackTree200, DeepCrack, GAPs384, Rissbilder), +8.0% Dice and IoU over SOTA.
adaptation: Benchmark suite entry as the diffusion crack baseline: 1-ch input, 512 px, crack-only head or 24-class head; not a refiner.
min_experiment: Arm: CrossDiff reimplementation, 3 seeds. Baseline: house 5-seed. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill: below house on both.
